load_state_file: load a torax simulation state file from disk and return it as an xr.DataTree
concat_datatrees: concat two xr.DataTrees along the time dimension keeping the first occurrence of duplicate time steps
stitch_state_files: stitch a new simulation datatree to the end of a previous restart state file
build_simulation_output_xr: build an xr.DataTree of simulation output from a StateHistory instance with profiles scalars and numerics
save_core_profiles: save stacked core profiles including temperature density current and transport to xr.DataArrays
